importantFindings: A staff row read complete on one text line with its role code missed can still look ready: 3 rows on 2 of 40 perturbed inputs with erasure, 2 rows on 2 inputs without, 0 on the five captures. The fix belongs in the review screen (table-band gate); StudentScan.tsx is under another agent's active work, so it is recorded and proposed as a follow-up rather than changed here.
Erasure is not uniformly better: on the shadowed capture, rotated or JPEG inputs get more flags and rows with erasure. Totals across 25 inputs still halve the rows to review.

On the fictitious staff sheet Tesseract's layout drops the whole student age column after erasure. It is a layout instability (masking unrelated staff cells toggles it), not observed on the real captures; the age then follows from the read birth date. Kept as its own sheet with honest bounds rather than loosening the five registers' bounds.

Samples 1 and 2 have more flags than at the first erasure commit (5 and 24 vs 0 and 17) because the band gate refuses the staff joins that produced the ready-looking row; this is the intended safety trade.

The compound presentation changed: an unproven surname-first three-word name now shows the first word as surname. The row stays blocked until the operator confirms the split; 10 of the 17-field wrong-name reduction at the first erasure commit came from this presentation, as disclosed.

On two perturbed sample-4 inputs Tesseract loses whole rows in both modes; erasure raises page confidence above the retake threshold on those, so the retake warning shows in neither with erasure. A row-count cue independent of page confidence is recorded as a follow-up.

tests/ocr-synthetic-regression.test.ts now runs in Vitest's node environment. Under the default jsdom environment Tesseract.js resolved the relative language path as a URL and only worked because a cached ita.traineddata sat in the repository root; removing that cache in the sweep (review S4-DI-Q8) made the test fetch and fail, as it would on a fresh CI checkout. In node it reads the bundled data from node_modules and passes without the cache.
